name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause 'unlock the door eventually' (Existence(door_open)) is redundant given the combination of hard Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) along with environment constraints that prevent target_picked_up before door_open. Checklist 6 specifies rejecting redundant Existence clauses to maintain compactness.

texts: move the blocker before opening the door
acquire the matching key before opening the door
unlock the door before picking up the box
